label: benign
title: Police non-emergency line: your wallet was turned in
sources: Hard negative for law-enforcement impostors: a real officer, no threat, no payment

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Officer Diaz at the Maple Street station. Someone turned in a wallet with your ID in it.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh, thank goodness, I've been looking everywhere.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can pick it up at the front desk any day this week. Just bring another form of ID.
